testcase.name: Scenario: Change the Favorites pane view mode: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:327:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Change the Favorites pane view mode ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part with a visible block is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Favorites pane is open with Tree View selected ✔ When the user opens the Favorites view-mode menu ✔ Then Tree View is checked and Thumbnail View is available ✔ When the user chooses Thumbnail View ✔ Then the view-mode control displays Thumbnail View ✔ And the pane shows its content-location control ✔ And the block remains visible in the same apparent view ✔ When the user reopens the view-mode menu ✔ Then Thumbnail View is checked ✔ When the user chooses Tree View ✔ Then the view-mode control displays Tree View ✔ When the user closes the Favorites tab ✔ Then the Model browser is displayed again
